notes.title: Meet Alejandro!
notes.content:
[h3]What would Freud think?[/h3]

[i]Alejandro[/i] is father of three members of our studio—[i]Chavo[/i], [i]Augusto[/i] and [i]me[/i]—so we've decided to model him in 3D. Now he's one of the four main characters of [b]The Parrot That Summons Demons[/b] (and our pet actor!)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YzHT8KG.gif[/img]

I mean, [b]The Parrot That Summons Demons[/b] can be described as a family tragedy/horror game, so what's better than including members of our actual family in our own game? 

Nothing can go wrong, right?

RIGHT?
